title: Procyon
tagline: 🦝 Your raccoon copilot for crypto — talk to your wallet in plain english.
description: Managing crypto today means reading unreadable explorers, judging risk yourself, and fighting technical DEX parameters. Procyon replaces all of it with one sentence: you ask in natural language and an AI agent fetches the answer from live on-chain data, then tells you what actually matters — risk, concentration, dead or spam tokens — instead of dumping a raw table.
how_its_made: Procyon also treats ENS as first-class AI-agent infrastructure. It has its own ENS identity, and it can resolve, verify, and discover other AI agents by their ENS name using the emerging agent standards: ENSIP-25 registration, ENSIP-26 endpoints, and the ENSIP-27 agent card. So the same copilot that reads your wallet is itself a named, verifiable, discoverable on-chain agent.
auto_summary: An AI wallet copilot that analyzes live token holdings, resolves ENS-based agent identities, and prepares Uniswap swaps from natural-language requests.
